items.source: Resolves a method parameter into an argument value from a given request. A ModelAndViewContainer provides access to the model for the request. A WebDataBinderFactory provides a way to create a WebDataBinder instance when needed for data binding and type conversion purposes.
items.translation: 将方法参数解析为来自给定请求的参数值。ModelAndViewContainer 提供对请求模型的访问。当需要用于数据绑定和类型转换时，WebDataBinderFactory 提供了一种创建 WebDataBinder 实例的方法。

items.source: Whether the given method parameter is supported by this resolver.
items.translation: 给定方法参数是否由该解析器支持。

items.source: parameter - the method parameter to resolve. This parameter must have previously been passed to supportsParameter(MethodParameter) which must have returned true.
items.translation: parameter - 要解析的方法参数。此参数必须已传递给supportsParameter(MethodParameter)，且该方法必须返回true。

items.source:
Strategy interface for resolving method parameters into argument values in
the context of a given request.
items.translation: 用于在给定请求的上下文中将方法参数解析为参数值的策略接口。

items.source: Resolves a method parameter into an argument value from a given request.
items.translation: 将方法参数解析为给定请求中的参数值。

items.source: binderFactory - a factory for creating WebDataBinder instances
items.translation: binderFactory - 用于创建 WebDataBinder 实例的工厂

items.source: true if this resolver supports the supplied parameter; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果此解析器支持提供的参数；否则为 false。

items.source: Exception - in case of errors with the preparation of argument values
items.translation: Exception - 在准备参数值时发生错误的情况下

items.source: mavContainer - the ModelAndViewContainer for the current request
the resolved argument value, or null if not resolvable
items.translation: 解析后的参数值，或者如果无法解析则为null。
